$comment: Specification for an optional skill pack. No third-party content is stored in this repository; tools/vendor-sync.py --pack builds the pack repository from this pin. Nothing here is attached to a Project by default.

upstream.refNote: Pinned to the commit the local install was verified byte-identical to (375/375 files, 2026-09-19). HELD DELIBERATELY during the pack migration: upstream HEAD b052c32b carries 14 skill directories against this pin's 13, the extra one being nextjs-on-cloudflare. Moving the pin adds a skill that has never been in use here, so an upstream update is a separate change with its own evidence.

layout.$comment: The built pack repository MUST ship .claude/skills/<name> entries. Verified 2026-09-20 by treeless clone at upstream HEAD: cloudflare/skills ships zero such entries, so a repository carrying only skills/<name>/SKILL.md in upstream layout attaches to a Project and delivers nothing, with no error.
layout.provenance: PROVENANCE.json (upstream repo, ref, licence, per-file sha256)
layout.spec: PACK.json (a copy of this file, so the pack verifies offline on its own)
